cases.prompt: Add three fixed alternate greetings with different starting state to this MVU card.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve the detected dialect, select per-greeting initialization, and retain a real-runtime acceptance gate.

cases.prompt: Make this MVU zod card work with both same-generation updates and the extra update-model pass without duplicating every worldbook entry into both model contexts.
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify runtime support, keep the variable list intentionally shared, route update rules and output format to the update model, route plot-only instructions to the plot model, preserve normal activation, and require both-mode acceptance.

cases.prompt: Split this packaged rolecard JSON into reusable components without changing the original file.
cases.expectedBehavior: Snapshot the input, decompose in a sandbox, declare dependencies, and require roundtrip comparison.

cases.prompt: Assemble the maintained sources, validate them, and produce versioned JSON and PNG release artifacts.
cases.expectedBehavior: Discover the project adapter, keep source and artifacts separate, and stop at explicit release gates.

cases.prompt: Package card version 2.4.0 with its attached and standalone companion worldbook, making sure an older 2.3.0 worldbook cannot be selected.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve both artifacts from the active manifest by stable ID, require a machine-checkable version surface, compare attached and standalone worldbooks with maintained source, and reject the stale version.

cases.prompt: What is the exact event name and callback signature for this Tavern Helper MVU hook?
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify an identified source/version and distinguish confirmed facts from inference.

cases.prompt: The status bar works offline but is blank after importing the card into SillyTavern. Diagnose it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reproduce in a real runtime and trace DOM, console, iframe, permissions, data, and render evidence.

cases.prompt: Review and improve this rolecard control center for mobile, accessibility, and safe state handling.
cases.expectedBehavior: Review the embedded UI contract without introducing a React stack by default.

cases.prompt: Clean up and optimize this ugly but stable module.
cases.expectedBehavior: Audit and gate first; do not edit without evidence and implementation authorization.

cases.prompt: Build an accessible settings dashboard with React, shadcn/ui, Radix, and Tailwind.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the requested stack, detect the project setup, and guard all generated writes.

cases.prompt: The rolecard workshop publish request now returns 502. Diagnose the chain before changing production.
cases.expectedBehavior: Trace the configurable public/gateway/storage chain read-only and require authorization before deploy or secret changes.
